title: Skel-Net: automatic prediction of skeletal pattern on scanned lateral cephalograms using anatomical prior-guided deep learning network.
summary: The study uses five-year paired cephalograms from 245 children/adolescents; Skel-Net predicts future ANB angle changes with lower error than baseline networks. The dataset is single-center and no external validation is available.
ai_technology: Two-stage Ceph-Net landmark/heatmap extraction and anatomy-prior-guided DL predict five-year ANB change.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: 612 images from 245 untreated patients; held-out test split MAE 1.021 degrees, RMSE 1.338, R2 .517; beats listed DL baselines.
evidence.unknown: Primary BMC Oral Health Methods/Results use five-year paired cephalograms from 245 children/adolescents; Skel-Net predicts future ANB angle changes with lower error than baseline networks. Temporal paired films provide actual growth outcome; internal train/validation/test only and no external center limit generalization.
